summary: Configures IP, DHCP, PTP, IGMP, and SPS settings for supported ST 2110 video devices and exposes diagnostics through Info CHOP channels.
key_concepts: ST2110 Device CHOP is Pro-only and configures ST 2110 device IP, DHCP, PTP, and related network settings.
The operator configures devices but currently outputs no CHOP channels of its own.
Diagnostic state is exposed through Info CHOP channels such as packet counts, multicast changes, and PTP lock state.
Driver selects the hardware path, currently Blackmagic or Deltacast.
Primary-port DHCP/IP/subnet/gateway controls are separate from SPS port enablement and SPS DHCP/IP/subnet/gateway controls.
Pair this configuration CHOP with ST2110 In TOP or ST2110 Out TOP for actual video transport workflows.

key_params.name: usedhcp
key_params.note: Use DHCP for primary device port

key_params.name: ptpprofile
key_params.note: Off, ST2059-2, or AES67 PTP profile

key_params.name: vesion2
key_params.note: Use the official Version 2 IGMP menu id spelling

common_gotchas: Official docs list this operator as TouchDesigner Pro only.
The operator configures device settings but currently outputs no CHOP channels itself.
Use Info CHOP channels for diagnostics.
Generated plans should pair this with ST2110 In TOP or ST2110 Out TOP when actual video transport is needed.
Manual IP/PTP/IGMP settings must match the facility network; unsafe generated values can break device connectivity.
Driver selection is hardware-specific: Blackmagic and Deltacast are separate paths.
The docs spell the IGMP Version 2 menu id as `vesion2`; preserve the official parameter id even though it looks like a typo.
